source_note: Read from the issuer FY2025 earnings release income statement of 2 March 2026 (EGP, stored absolute). The printed chain ties to the unit: Net Revenues 76,597,057,544 less Cost of Sales 70,147,680,642 equals Gross Profit 6,449,376,902, and Profit Before Tax less income tax equals Net Profit. The release also prints Gross Revenues of 80,092,086,952 on the top line and net revenue is used here to match its own summary income statement. Operating Expenses is the printed Selling, General and Administrative Expenses; the expected credit loss charges are separate printed lines and are not folded into it. Operating Profit is the printed EBIT, after Depreciation and Amortization of 348,762,740. Net Finance Costs is derived as printed Financing Expenses less Financing Income, foreign currency revaluation gain and credit interest, which is what bridges EBIT to Profit Before Tax. Income Tax is the printed Current Income Taxes 256,985,432 less the printed Deferred income taxes benefit of 131,625,556. No EPS row: the release prints none.

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged. Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed.
